simple: A cloud secrets management service for applications, CI/CD pipelines, containers (Kubernetes, OpenShift) and automation (Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins) — formerly CyberArk Conjur Cloud. A program proves who it is by its own attributes (workload, cloud role, Kubernetes service account) and receives a password, token or key at run time — with no secrets in code, images or environment variables. Secrets are rotated regularly, and access follows policies with full audit. Licensed in machine secrets packs; for cloud and CI/CD environments — per region.
